name: OCG Treasure
description: Confiscation and The Forceful Sentry revealed the opponent's hand and removed a chosen card. Delinquent Duo attacked hand size directly, giving a player who drew these Spells early considerable control over the opening turns.

defining_cards.name: Confiscation
defining_cards.why: For 1000 LP it revealed the opponent's hand and discarded a chosen card, breaking combinations before either piece reached the field.

defining_cards.name: The Forceful Sentry
defining_cards.why: Seeing the opponent's hand and shuffling one card into the Deck removed an immediate threat without stocking their Graveyard.

defining_cards.name: Delinquent Duo
defining_cards.why: For 1000 LP it stripped two cards from a full opposing hand, including one chosen at random.

defining_cards.name: Snatch Steal
defining_cards.why: Taking an opposing monster gave the player an attacker or a tribute, with no need to summon a monster first.

defining_cards.name: Painful Choice
defining_cards.why: It sent four of five selected cards to the Graveyard, setting up revival and Graveyard effects even when the opponent chose the weakest card to keep.
